name: Gasthof Greif
kurzbeschreibung:
**Inns Greif in Tirol** Welcome to **Inns Greif**, a cozy and traditional guesthouse nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Just a short stroll from the vibrant center of **Innsbruck**, we invite you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a warm, rustic setting. Our family-run inn offers comfortable rooms with a touch of Alpine charm, where you can unwind after a day of exploring the stunning **Tirol** landscapes. Whether you're hiking through the **Zillertal** valleys, skiing on the slopes of **Nordkette**, or simply strolling through **Innsbruck’s** old town, our home is your perfect retreat. Savor classic Tyrolean dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Gröstl**, or a steaming bowl of **Käsespätzle** in our cozy dining room. Pair your meal with a glass of local **Tiroler Apfelstrudelwein** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** from the region’s finest breweries. After dinner, relax by the crackling fireplace or take a dip in our outdoor hot spring—just steps away from the inn. We’re also happy to help you plan unforgettable adventures, from guided hikes in the **Karwendel** to snowy excursions in the **Ötztal**. Come as a guest, leave as family—**Inns Greif** awaits you in the heart of **Tirol**! --- **

Your Home in Tirol

** **

Just minutes from Innsbruck’s city center, where tradition meets modern comfort.

** **

Rooms & Atmosphere

** **

** **

Activities & Excursions

** **

** **

Relaxation

** **
  • Outdoor hot spring with panoramic views
  • Sauna and massage services on request
  • Evening fireside chats with fellow travelers
** **

Plan Your Stay

** **

Whether you’re here for adventure, relaxation, or both, Inns Greif is your gateway to the magic of Tirol.

** **Contact us to book your stay today!**
